This is A.Sai Tarun of 8th semester.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: white;\"\u003E\u003Cspan\u003E\u003Cb\u003EThis is an online E log platform to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent. I have been given this case in order to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of patient's clinical data analysis to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb style=\"font-family: \u0026quot;Merriweather Sans\u0026quot;;\"\u003EDATE OF ADMISSION - 17\/08\/23\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb style=\"font-family: \u0026quot;Merriweather Sans\u0026quot;;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Merriweather Sans;\"\u003EA 29yr old female patient came to general medicine opd with cheif complaints of SOB since 3days.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Merriweather Sans;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Merriweather Sans;\"\u003EPatient was apparently aymptomatic till november 2022 . Then she had loss of hair and patches are developed.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Merriweather Sans;\"\u003EBilatera Pedal edema is present which is of pitting type.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Merriweather Sans;\"\u003EThen she developed shortness of breath \u0026nbsp;which is \u0026nbsp;insidious in onset and gradually progressive in nature.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ERenal biopsy was done and diagnosed with lupus nephritis and was on conservative management.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt was initially on hemodialysis since feb 2023\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Merriweather Sans;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHISTORY OF PAST ILLNESS\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Merriweather Sans;\"\u003EHe is a k\/c\/o HTN sicne feb 2023\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Merriweather Sans;\"\u003ENot a k\/c\/o DM,CVA,CVD,TB,Epilepsy,Asthma.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ETREATMENT HISTORY\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ek\/c\/o HTN and on
